Res.Caption: Constraint Threshold Multiple
Res.FullDescription: When a given resource has work waiting in the Release Gate with a total of standard estimates of at least this factor multiplied by the Buffer Timespan, the system will consider the resource as a capacity constrained candidate, pending designation as a nominated constrained resource.

Res.Caption: Non-CCR Overload Multiplier
Res.FullDescription: In order for non-capacity constrained resources to not restrict the flow of work to capacity constrained resources, this multiple is applied to the Buffer Load Limit percent when calculating non-CCR total capacity. This has the effect that total capacity for a non-CCR is usually higher than a CCR, whilst preventing occasional surges of work to a non-CCR.

Res.Caption: Buffer Load Limit Percent
Res.FullDescription: The percentage of the Buffer Timespan which can be consumed for any resource.

Res.Caption: Auto Assign Tasks Age
Res.FullDescription: The duration a workflow can spend in a buffer (using the buffer's Department and Branch hours) before it becomes eligible for auto-assignment. This value is used if there is no age at a Capability or Release Group level. 000:00 indicates assignment immediately after release.

Res.Caption: Aging Branch
Res.FullDescription: The branch to use when calculating aging of workflows in this component.

Res.Caption: Aging Department
Res.FullDescription: The department to use when calculating aging of workflows in this component.
